result:
The fix is in place:

- **`tsconfig.app.json`** (new) — contains all the app-specific compiler options and `"include": ["src"]`, moved from `tsconfig.json`
- **`tsconfig.json`** (updated) — now a proper solution file that just references `tsconfig.app.json` and `tsconfig.node.json`

This matches the standard Vite 5+ project structure. The `tsc` command in `npm run build` will now correctly resolve both referenced configs.
